card.name: Relatedness and concurrent-use modifiers
card.fires_on: The word 'related' after an adverb like structurally or closely, and the ending of 'concomitantly' or 'concurrently' before administered or used drugs. Also 'neighboring' before a noun.

modes.label: Related compounds
modes.description: 'related' or 'neighboring' after an adverb, describing similar compounds or nearby places.
modes.example: hypersensitivity to the drug or to structurally<< related>> compounds.

modes.label: Concomitantly administered
modes.description: The ending of 'concomitantly' or 'concurrently' before administered or used drugs in interaction text.
modes.example: may reduce the absorption of concomit<<antly>> administered oral iron preparations.

card.plain: It marks words saying a drug is chemically similar or taken at the same time as another drug.
